Q3 AND Q5 RULED at post-01M19V74MVE7S3NNK8GTK7HJGW. This bead is now fully specified and waiting only on an agent.

Q3 -- NOTHING IS REWRITTEN WHOLESALE AND NOTHING IS RENDERED; THE SITE IS AUTHORED.
  CITED by exact path and SHA, never reproduced: the 7 ADRs. They are decisions WITH DISSENT ATTACHED and the dissent is the valuable part -- summarising one destroys what makes it trustworthy, linking one lets a sceptical reader check whether the objection was answered.
  INTERNAL, unlinked: docs/plans (10), docs/reviews (3), AGENTS.md, this board. AGENTS.md especially: thirty-five sub-rules of accumulated incident, most of it meaningless without the incident, and publishing it invites a reader to mistake our scar tissue for our design.
  CASE BY CASE: docs/design (12) -- some are admission ledgers and gate records, some are genuine exposition.
  FIRST CANDIDATE FOR PUBLIC ADAPTATION: docs/CONSTITUTION.md.

Q5 -- IN-REPO UNDER docs-site/, NOT A SIBLING REPOSITORY. The reason is specific: the site must cite exact SHAs, and a sibling repo reintroduces the source-pin problem we already carry twice (grakern pinned by SHA, storyatlas4s building this from source). Both pins cost real time this week. A separate repo would drift and nothing would notice.

  NOTHING BUILDS IT TODAY -- no CI, no docs project in build.sbt, no package.json -- so THE SITE MUST CARRY ITS OWN BUILD RECEIPT VISIBLE ON THE PAGE: the exact commit it was generated from, and the date, somewhere a reader checking currency will find it. That is the derived-identity rule turned on the documentation itself. Without CI, "this site is current" is a claim nobody can check, and an uncheckable claim of currency is worse than a stale site honestly labelled.

  IT GATES NOTHING while no CI exists.

STILL OPEN AND NOT MINE: Q4's Starlight-versus-custom, which needs m1's byte-verbatim test -- can the framework serve a self-contained HTML file without rewriting or injecting? Answerable by experiment, not argument, and by whoever builds it.

STATE OF THIS BEAD: rulings on Q1, Q2, Q3, Q5, Q6; a hard constraint (pointing Astro at docs/ publishes repository archaeology); a criterion for Q4; an evidence-status scheme (Confirmed / Qualified / Intent with provenance underneath); and the standing constraint that the site must never be more confident than the README. Unassigned. Ready for an agent.
